title: Estimation of Room Impulse Responses from Handclaps
abstract: arXiv:2609.35839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Handclaps provide an equipment-free excitation for room acoustics, but their unknown and variable source waveform makes room impulse response (RIR) estimation challenging. In this work, we investigate whether RIRs can be estimated directly from handclaps. To this end, we introduce an anechoic handclap dataset containing 2,540 claps from 17 participants, designed to capture variability across natural claps and different hand configurations. We first establish the performance attainable when the excitation clap is known using regularized deconvolution, and show that approximating the unknown excitation by windowing the direct sound from the reverberant recording is insufficient. To estimate the RIR without a known excitation, we propose using the anechoic handclap recordings to train a deep neural network with a supervised regression objective. translated_title: 基于拍手声的房间脉冲响应估计
translated_abstract: 拍手声为房间声学提供了一种无需任何设备的激励方式，但其未知且多变的源波形使得房间脉冲响应（RIR）的估计极具挑战性。在本工作中，我们研究了能否直接从拍手声估计房间脉冲响应。为此，我们构建了一个消声环境下的拍手数据集，包含来自17名参与者的2,540次拍手，旨在捕捉自然拍手以及不同手部形态带来的变异性。我们首先利用正则化反卷积方法确定了在已知激励拍手信号时可达到的性能，并表明通过从混响录音中对直达声部分加窗来近似未知激励的方法是不够充分的。为了在激励信号未知的情况下估计房间脉冲响应，我们提出利用消声拍手录音数据，以监督回归为目标训练一个深度神经网络。在受控的合成基准上进行评估，所提出的神经回归器表现显著更优。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含2,540次拍手的消声拍手数据集，并提出利用监督回归深度神经网络直接从未知激励的拍手声中估计房间脉冲响应。
en_tdlr: A deep neural network trained on an anechoic dataset of 2,540 handclaps enables room impulse response estimation directly from handclaps without requiring knowledge of the excitation signal.
